title: zazzled use cases
description: Reaching the zazzle commands over MCP, and having launchd start the daemon.

entities.name: Use the zazzle tools over MCP
entities.description: A coding agent's MCP client starts `zazzled mcp` and calls the zazzle tools; each call is answered by the shared daemon without a process spawn.
entities.goal: Search, read, outline and edit the project's files, and ask about its C# structure and history, through tools, with short answers it is not sent twice and can fetch again by id.
preconditions: The MCP client is configured to start `zazzled mcp` (for example `claude mcp add zazzle -- zazzled mcp`), in the project directory.
The zazzled binary can start `zazzled serve` from its own path, or a daemon already listens on the socket.
postconditions: Each tool call has been answered with the command's text, tagged with a response id for this connection's session.
One daemon serves every call; the MCP process spawns nothing per call.

flow.action: Its MCP client starts `zazzled mcp` and sends initialize.
Agrees the protocol version the client asked for if it knows it (2025-06-18, 2025-03-26 or 2024-11-05), else the newest, as server `zazzle`; the process already has its random session id.

Lists the tools and gets zazzle_find, zazzle_read, zazzle_read_again, zazzle_ls, zazzle_outline, zazzle_refs, zazzle_edit, zazzle_overview, zazzle_find_symbol, zazzle_changed_since, zazzle_git_log, zazzle_git_blame and zazzle_report_gap with their input schemas.
Calls a tool with JSON arguments, for example zazzle_read with paths.
Turns the arguments into a zazzle command line.
Sends the command line with its working directory and session to the daemon in relay mode; if no daemon listens, starts `zazzled serve` detached and retries with backoff for up to 3 seconds.
Returns the daemon's text as the tool result, marked isError when the command's status is not 0.

alternatives.condition: An argument has the wrong type, or a required one is missing.
alternatives.outcome: A tool result with isError and `error: ...`; the daemon is not called.

alternatives.condition: The daemon cannot be started, or does not listen within 3 seconds.
alternatives.outcome: A tool result with isError and `error: cannot reach zazzled: ...`.

alternatives.condition: The same answer was already sent in this session within the last 40,000 estimated tokens, and the call did not set disable_session_deduping.
alternatives.outcome: The result is `[r:ID] already sent: ..., unchanged. If you no longer have it: read-again r:ID` instead of the text; zazzle_read_again with that id returns it.

entities.name: Have launchd start the daemon
entities.description: A developer installs the LaunchAgent once, and from then on launchd starts zazzled when anything connects.
entities.goal: The daemon is there whenever a zazzle invoker or MCP server connects, without anyone starting it.
preconditions: A Mac, with zazzled built or installed where it will stay (the plist names its path).
postconditions: launchd owns the socket and starts `zazzled serve` on demand; the daemon exits when idle and launchd keeps listening.
`zazzled uninstall` unloads the agent and removes the plist.

flow.action: Writes ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.zazzle.zazzled.plist: this executable with `serve`, and a listener socket at ZAZZLE_SOCK or the default path with mode 0600.
Runs `launchctl bootout` for any loaded copy (ignoring failure), then `launchctl bootstrap gui/UID PLIST`, each with a 10-second limit, and prints `installed PATH`.
When launchd starts it on a connection, takes launchd's socket instead of binding one, serves, and exits when idle without removing the socket.

alternatives.outcome: `zazzled: install is for macOS launchd; elsewhere the invoker starts zazzled on demand`, exit 2.
The path and the error, exit 2.

alternatives.condition: launchctl bootstrap fails or runs past 10 seconds.
alternatives.outcome: `launchctl bootstrap ... failed` or `... timed out`, exit 2; the plist stays written.
